evals.name: fixes-flags-keeps-facts
evals.prompt: This reads like AI, clean it up: 'Our new pipeline serves as a robust foundation — it's not just faster, it's a testament to the team. In order to ship, we cut build time from 12 minutes to 4.'
evals.expected_output: Runs the checker, rewrites without the dash, 'serves as', 'robust', the manufactured contrast, 'a testament to' and 'in order to', keeps the 12 to 4 minutes fact, and reports flag counts before and after.
assertions: The checker script was run on the draft
The rewrite has no em-dash, 'serves as', 'robust', 'testament' or 'in order to'
The rewrite still says build time went from 12 minutes to 4
The reply gives the flag count before and after

evals.name: quotes-stay
evals.prompt: Check this before I send it: 'The error said "failed to leverage cache" so I cleared it and the build passed.'
evals.expected_output: Leaves 'leverage' inside the quoted error message and says so in one line.
assertions: The quoted error message is unchanged
The reply explains in one line why that flag stays
